label: 区域外缘是否为矩形
description: 检测区域的有效格是否紧贴其自身外接矩形四条边完全填满：true=外缘正好是一个方正矩形（如被裁切的开放海域/无限延伸的地表，外缘不代表天然边界）；false=外缘凹凸不规则（天然海岸线/地形轮廓）。常用于自动决定「是否把区域外缘当作距离场源」。
description-en: Detects whether a region's valid cells completely fill all four edges of its own tight bounding box: true = the outer edge is an exact rectangle (e.g. a cropped open sea / terrain that just continues past the tile, not a natural boundary); false = the outer edge is irregular (a natural coastline/terrain outline). Useful for auto-deciding whether a region's outer edge should act as a distance-field source.
icon: 深色背景上一个完整实心方框代表矩形边缘，旁边一个边缘带缺口的不规则形状代表天然轮廓，两者对比，扁平插画风格，简洁小图标，主色2种。

inputs.name: region
inputs.label: 输入区域
inputs.description: 0/1 或多值区域 grid，非零格为有效格。
inputs.description-en: 0/1 or multi-value region grid; non-zero cells are valid.

outputs.name: isRect
outputs.label: 外缘是否为矩形
outputs.description: true=有效格紧贴自身外接矩形四条边完全填满（外缘是方正矩形，无天然边界）；false=外接矩形边上存在空缺格（外缘是天然/有机轮廓）。无有效格时输出 false。
outputs.description-en: true = valid cells fully cover all four edges of the tight bounding box (rectangular outer edge, no natural boundary); false = the bounding box edge has gaps (irregular/organic outer edge). Outputs false when there are no valid cells.
